record.field: Màn hình này dùng để làm gì?

Six things each add points: it needs a reply (40), there's a visit today (30), unread messages (15), a missed call (10), and it used a phrase we watch for (15). 40+30+15+10+15 = 110. Waiting longer adds more.
Vì sao cuộc hội thoại #4172 là 110?
The urgency score is arithmetic, not an opinion. For #4172 six terms add up:
It is a queue position, not a clinical severity. A 110 tells you to look now; it tells you nothing about the patient's condition.
At 11:42 the same conversation reads 114: the ageing term becomes +4, one point per whole hour of waiting, capped at 20.
Care Command's stored urgency computation, and conversation #4172 in this practice tenant.
Why must I claim before replying?
Why must I claim before replying?
Vì sao phải nhận xử lý trước khi trả lời?
Claiming makes you the single owner of the conversation. Without it, two operators can answer the same family within a minute of each other — the most common complaint this wall exists to prevent.
Open the conversation from the wall.
Press Claim on the ownership banner.
Reply, book or escalate as the owner.
Release when you go off shift.
If two of you claim in the same second, exactly one wins and the other is shown who owns it. Nothing is lost and nothing is duplicated.
Care Command's claim, release and take-over service methods.
Can I take a conversation off a colleague?
Can I take a conversation off a colleague?
Tôi có tiếp quản được cuộc hội thoại của đồng nghiệp không?
Taking an owned conversation off someone else needs the CRM Manager permission. Your CRM / Reception role can claim unclaimed conversations and release your own, but not take one from a colleague.
A CRM Manager, or the Owner.
Ask the owner to press Release, or ask {{accessRequestPath}} to take it over. If the owner is off shift and the item is urgent, escalate it — that reaches a clinician without changing ownership.
Care Command is not in your sidebar. This leaf is gated to the Owner and CRM roles in the database, so a Nurse account does not see the wall at all.
Owner, CRM / Reception, and CRM Managers.
You do not need it for clinical work — escalations reach you through your own queue. If you genuinely need the wall, {{accessRequestPath}} can request the CRM role for your account.
Yes. As Operations Manager you hold the CRM Manager permission, so Take over is available to you on any owned conversation in your catchment area.
It reassigns silently. The previous owner is not asked, and if they are mid-reply you can both end up answering. Say something first.
Care Command's take-over method, which refuses any caller without the CRM Manager permission.
Yes — the Owner role carries every CRM permission, including Take over across all catchment areas.
Same caution as any manager: it reassigns silently, so tell the previous owner.
Care Command's take-over method, and the Owner role's CRM permissions.
What actually happens if I mark this Junk?
What actually happens if I mark this Junk?
Đánh dấu Thư rác? thì thật ra chuyện gì xảy ra?
It does two things, not one. It zeroes the urgency score and takes the row off the wall — and it marks the linked contact as spam and flags the phone number for the future.

The consequence lands on the next operator: the same number calls in three weeks and arrives pre-judged. In home care, a family member messaging on a patient's behalf is the normal case, so “this is not the patient's account” is never on its own a reason to mark junk.
Check whether the number matches an existing client first.
If it is a real person you cannot help, use Closed, not Junk?.
Reserve Junk? for advertising, wrong numbers and bots.
Care Command's set-status method, which additionally runs the CRM spam path on the linked lead.
The daughter is asking about her mother's wound — can I answer?
The daughter is asking about her mother's wound — can I answer?
Người con gái hỏi về vết thương của mẹ — tôi trả lời được không?

Not from the clinical detail. Family relationship is not consent. What you may share with a named other person is a recorded permission — a Data Sharing consent — with a state you must actually look at.
For this case the consent exists but was withdrawn on 30 June 2026, which is an explicit “no” from the patient herself, not a missing record.
Open Consents on the action strip and read the state and the date.
Reply acknowledging the concern, without clinical content.
Escalate the clinical question to the {{roleDutyDoctor}}.
Call the client's own registered number — that route needs no third-party consent.
Being fast is still right. Reply inside {{replySlaMinutes}} minutes — just not with the thing you are not permitted to say.
The consent record for Nguyễn Thị Hoa in this practice tenant, and the Data Sharing consent type.
The wall has gone quiet — where do I look?
The wall has gone quiet — where do I look?
Bảng bỗng yên ắng — tôi phải xem ở đâu?
Two very different shapes, and they need opposite responses:
Volume DISAPPEARED — check the Channel Center states. A channel outside Connected or Expiring soon neither sends nor receives, and nothing queues.
Volume MOVED to another team — check the catchment area on each Official Account. That field is the routing rule.
Neither? Check your own catchment filter at the top of the wall before you conclude anything.
Do not re-authorise as a diagnostic. It takes the channel out of service while it walks the path again, so you would add a real outage to whatever you were investigating.
Channel connection lifecycle states, and the catchment derivation that prefers the channel account the traffic arrived on.
Tỷ lệ chuyển đổi được tính thế nào?
Conversion Rate is a month figure — bookings as a share of real enquiries, with spam excluded from the denominator. This month:
Do not compare it with Contacts Today, which is a day figure. Different windows, always. Lead Analysis only reconciles with this card when you match both the period and the catchment filter.
A falling Spam Rate is not automatically good news: it can also mean nobody is marking spam, which inflates the denominator and quietly depresses conversion.
The six KPI definitions on the CRM Dashboard, and this practice tenant's August figures.
Why are four enquiries in “Unmatched campaigns”?
Why are four enquiries in “Unmatched campaigns”?
Vì sao có bốn yêu cầu nằm trong “Chiến dịch chưa khớp”?
Because they arrived with no UTM tags and no click id, so nothing identifies the advert. Of this month's 34 website enquiries: 19 google / cpc, 11 facebook / paid, 4 unmatched.
This is almost always fixable at the source: somebody published a link without tags. It is a repeating leak, not noise.
Do not assume the touchpoint and the conversation share a channel. Someone can click a Google advert on Monday and message Zalo on Wednesday — the two are joined by phone number, not by channel.
The web touchpoint records for August in this practice tenant.
What do I do with an unrouted contact?
What do I do with an unrouted contact?
Tôi phải làm gì với một liên hệ chưa được định tuyến?

Convert it if it carries at least one anchor — a contact, a phone number or an email address. Dismiss it if it genuinely was not a patient. You cannot edit it: the record is evidence of exactly what the channel sent.
Dismissal is recorded against your name with a reason. It is an answer, not a way to clear the badge count.
Read what actually arrived — page, comment text, whatever identity the provider sent.
Convert if there is an anchor; the item becomes a conversation on the wall.
Otherwise dismiss with a reason a colleague could audit.
The unrouted-contact model, whose fields are immutable outside the server paths.
When should I escalate, and to whom?
When should I escalate, and to whom?
Khi nào nên chuyển cấp, và cho ai?

Escalate when the question needs clinical judgement you are not qualified to give, or when someone is describing something that may not wait. It routes to the {{roleHeadNurse}}, the {{roleOpsManager}} or the {{roleDutyDoctor}}.
It needs a lead on the conversation and it pages a real person. That is the cost — and it is a much smaller cost than a wound question answered by reception.
Escalating is never the wrong call when you are unsure. Guessing is.
Care Command's escalate action and the CRM escalation targets.
Someone just walked in — how do I log it?
Someone just walked in — how do I log it?
Có khách đến trực tiếp — ghi nhận thế nào?
Log a walk-in from the wall. It needs a contact, a phone number or an email so the person can be followed up — a walk-in with no way to reach them afterwards is not a record, it is a memory.
Walk-in is the one channel a human logs by hand, and the only conversation channel you cannot connect in the Channel Center — a person coming through the door has no provider and no credentials.
Care Command's walk-in action, and the connectable-channel list that deliberately excludes it.
How do I make sure this gets followed up?
How do I make sure this gets followed up?
Làm sao để chắc chắn việc này được theo dõi?

Set a Reminder on the conversation. It schedules a real activity on the lead or contact, which then appears on the shared Activities board — that board is what turns “we'll call you back” into being called back.
Closing an activity without updating the contact's status makes the board go green while the Dashboard stays wrong. Do both.
Reminder and Internal note are the two safe actions when you are not sure what to say. Neither reaches the patient.
Care Command's reminder action and the shared activity board.
Why can't I see a conversation a colleague can?
Why can't I see a conversation a colleague can?
Vì sao đồng nghiệp thấy cuộc hội thoại mà tôi không thấy?

Almost always the catchment area. Every count and every list on these screens is filtered to your area, and for channel traffic the area comes from the channel account the message arrived on — one Zalo Official Account per area.
Check the catchment chip at the top of the wall — that is your current filter.
If the whole team is missing traffic, check the area on the channel account itself.
The second case is the dangerous one: a connection pointed at the wrong area re-routes a whole city with no error and no warning.
The catchment derivation, which prefers the channel account the traffic arrived on.
Which actions here can I not undo?
Which actions here can I not undo?
Thao tác nào ở đây không hoàn tác được?
Cannot be undone: sending a reply — it reaches a real phone from the clinic's official account, with no draft and no recall.
Partly reversible: “Junk?” (the status can be set back, but the phone number stays flagged) and booking (the visit can be cancelled, but a wrongly-matched client has already been written to).
Freely reversible: claim and release, internal notes, reminders, opening consents. When you are unsure, these are where to start.
The reversibility of each Care Command action, as the service methods implement it.
Tiếp theo tôi nên làm gì?
Can you tell me something clinical about this patient?
vết thương có nhiễm trùng không
Can you tell me something clinical about this patient?
Bạn có thể cho tôi biết thông tin lâm sàng về bệnh nhân này không?

No — I do not answer clinical questions, and I never will. I explain how CareJioX works; I hold no view on a wound, a dose, a reading or a diagnosis, and a confident-sounding answer from me about any of those would be worth nothing.

Use Escalate on the conversation — it reaches a clinician and records that you asked, which a phone call does not. If nobody is on shift and it cannot wait, ring the client's own number and follow the clinic's escalation route.
Answering a clinical question yourself, even a small one, is the single fastest way this desk causes harm. Speed is met by escalating fast, not by answering.
CareJioX's escalation route. Nothing clinical: this answer exists to refuse, not to inform.
How much is wound care at home?
How much is wound care at home?
Chăm sóc vết thương tại nhà giá bao nhiêu?
In this practice tenant, a 60-minute wound-care visit at home is priced at {PRICE}, and the 8-visit package at {PACK} — which is {SAVE} less than eight single visits.

These are the practice tenant's figures, not your clinic's price list. I will not quote a real price: prices vary by facility, service and area, and quoting a wrong one to a patient is a promise you then have to break.
This tutorial's worked example only. Your real prices live in the price list, which I do not read.
What do I do about an unassigned booking?
What do I do about an unassigned booking?
Lịch hẹn chưa phân công thì xử lý thế nào?

Assign somebody to it, and do it while it is still a scheduling task rather than a phone call. Unassigned in the morning is administration; unassigned in the afternoon is a family wondering where the nurse is.
Open the booking from the Unassigned list.
Check who has room on the Staff Schedule for that time.
Check the districts on either side before you commit.
Do not leave it because it is not urgent yet. The whole cost of this task is measured in how late you start it.
The Operations Dashboard's unassigned count and the booking list behind it.
Should I cancel this or reschedule it?
Should I cancel this or reschedule it?

Reschedule unless the visit genuinely is not needed. Reschedule keeps the booking, the client link and the revenue and simply moves them; cancel ends all three and the family has to start again from an enquiry.
A cancelled booking is not un-cancelled. A replacement is a new booking, and the patient has already been told nobody is coming.
The booking actions on the Bookings screen.
If I approve leave, what happens to that day's visits?
If I approve leave, what happens to that day's visits?
Nếu tôi duyệt nghỉ, các lượt của ngày đó ra sao?
Nothing happens to them. Approving makes the person unavailable and leaves every visit exactly where it is, still on their row, looking completely normal.
Open the Staff Schedule for every date being requested.
Reassign the visits that fall on those dates.
Then approve, once nothing depends on that person.
Approving first is the single most common way a fully-booked day becomes an unstaffed one, precisely because nothing on any screen complains.
The approval flow on Time Off, and the schedule it does not touch.
Hôm nay ai thật sự còn chỗ trống?

The workload bars answer capacity, not proximity. Somebody at 1 of 6 has room on paper; whether they can reach a visit in another district at that time is a different question with a different screen.
Equal counts across unequal distances is not fairness — it is just a tidier chart. Read the bars next to the districts.
Load against capacity on Workload, and the district column on Bookings.
Who reconciles the cash, and what if it does not balance?
Who reconciles the cash, and what if it does not balance?
Ai đối soát tiền mặt, và nếu không khớp thì sao?
Operations does, at end of shift. Finance receives one already-balanced figure and never chases an individual nurse — if it does not balance, it is settled here first.
Sending an unbalanced figure onward to be sorted out is the one thing this screen exists to prevent.
The cash held per member of staff, against today's visits.
Why can't I see the Operations screens?
không mở được lịch nhân sự
Why can't I see the Operations screens?
Vì sao tôi không thấy các màn hình Vận hành?
Every Operations screen except Clients is gated to the Operations Manager and Owner roles in the database. A nurse or a CRM operator does not see them at all — that is the design, not a fault.
Ask {{accessRequestPath}}. If what you actually need is one answer rather than the screen — where a visit is, who is going — the person holding that role can tell you in a sentence.
The role gate on each Operations sidebar leaf.
